fusions.name: Royal Edict
fusions.desc: Hurls you at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Silence in Court
fusions.desc: Strikes a ring around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Proclamation
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Tithe Collected
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
